replies.author: ForkedPush
replies.body: Thanks! This particular animation key is something I made. Claude usually fails to do passable close up hand poses. So I am using a tool in unity to manually adjust animation keys so that some parts of the animations look passable. I am not an animator so it may look off to some of you guys

comments.author: illlgames
comments.body: nice very nice. At first, I thought the male character was mouthless, check the video at 0:06. It looks funny and maybe you can keep it that way. Overall, the graphics look great. Could be a game I would play late at night !

replies.author: ForkedPush
replies.body: Hey thank you 😊  I am getting mixed feedback about character faces now. But I personally feel they could be improved, so I am going to make something I trully like and hope for the best.

replies.author: illlgames
replies.body: I also think it would be cool, if player can chase the bird that stole his fish to get it back. what to do you think about that ?

replies.author: ForkedPush
replies.body: That's a nice idea, you can actually do that. It lands to eat the fish it stole. You can chase it away. Hmm, should I also make it drop the fish after a few chases or randomly during a scare animation? That would be a nice addition imo

replies.author: illlgames
replies.body: yes, but it should be rare. Sometimes it should fly away, and lastly maybe a bunch of stones should lay around that we can collect, so when the bird comes and flies around with the fish, we can aim and hit it and take the fish back. I don't know what others would think about this, but I believe it would add more fun :)
